system.description:
Tech

Alter your facial features and pigmentation, giving you advantage on a roll to hide your true identity.

Charged: Spend a Charge to perfectly imitate the appearance and clothing of a specific creature you have seen. Place a number of tokens equal to your Power trait on this card. When you take an action while this effect is active, spend a token from this card. After the last token is resolved, the effect ends.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v2.0 Mind

system.gmNotes: Charges are stored on this card's resource. Place them by hand (instead of gaining Hope on a success with Hope, or by marking a Stress on a success with Fear); a long rest clears them. The card's resource holds Charges, so the duration tokens (equal to your Power trait) are tracked by hand.
